name: Huzza Fen
source_profile: ● Huzza Fen (NE) is a wealthy broker who trades in obscure subterranean goods. Huzza has quietly begun purchasing metalwork from suspicious dwarven intermediaries and reselling it through legitimate Cinderhook workshops.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 51 (source excerpt; may be partial)
